steps.message:
Found the issue: this repo's config aliases `immutable_heads()` to `bookmarks()` (in `/root/.config/jj/repos/c74de1f2d5e93c085f05/config.toml`), which makes *every* bookmark's ancestors immutable — not just `main`. Since `retry-backoff` points at a descendant of `main`, it drags the whole stack (including "fix nonce handling") into immutability. There's no remote configured, so falling back to the default `trunk()` wouldn't protect anything either.

I'll scope `immutable_heads()` to just `main` — that keeps `main` and its ancestors protected but frees the rest of your stack.
